episodes.synopsis: "Hey Fujiki, you got a New Year's card from Midori-chan, right? So why haven't you sent a reply? If you're such an indifferent person, no one will want to pair you up with them in the shuttlecock tournament!"
episodes.title: "Noguchi-san, are you excited about shuttlecock?" "Fujiki is overwhelmed by New Year's cards"

episodes.synopsis: "What?! Why does Maruko have to go to hell? She hasn't done anything particularly bad! I know I often oversleep and am late, but I'm Princess Maruko from Sleeping Forest, so it can't be helped."
episodes.title: "Is Maruko a Sleeping Beauty?" "Hell is scary."

episodes.synopsis: "I was lent a nice watch. Now I won't be late the next time I go to the zoo. From today on, I'm "the punctual Maruko"! I think I'll ask Tama-chan's dad to take a picture of me."
episodes.title: "Tama-chan gets angry at her father" "Maruko's dream watch"

episodes.synopsis: "What's wrong with Bootaro, who hates birthdays so much? Maybe he's worried about something. Is there no one he can talk to? For me, it would be Tama-chan. I can tell her about almost anything." The next two episodes of Chibi Maruko-chan are "Bootaro's Birthday" and "Maruko and Tama-chan, a secret between the two of us." Please look forward to them.
episodes.title: "Bootaro's Birthday" "Maruko and Tama-chan's Secret"

episodes.synopsis: "Hey Dad, Mommy isn't feeling well so please help me out around the house a little. I'm sorry but I'm busy right now. I'm going to audition for a child actor soon so I have a lot of things to do."
episodes.title: "One Day's Lunch Box" "Is Maruko a Genius Child Actor?"

episodes.synopsis: "Oh, so your mom and dad used to skate together when they were younger. Maybe that's what made them close? If you go skating with Ohno, maybe you can beat your love rival."
episodes.title: "Valentine's Day for a Girl in Love" "Let's go skating with the family!"

episodes.synopsis: "I heard there's a diary that makes you happy just by writing down the good things that happened that day. But I don't have any good things happening to me. And tomorrow's school lunch will have raw tomatoes, which I don't like. I wish they'd change the menu."
episodes.title: "What's for lunch today?" "Maruko, keep a happy diary"

episodes.synopsis: "Oh, Kayo-chan, are you going to give that to Sugiyama-kun as a present? It's still cold out. I'm sure he'll be happy. Also, why don't you make him some warm oden? I have a ton of daikon radishes at home, so take some!"
episodes.title: "Kayo-chan's Scarf" "Sakura Family's Radish Incident"

episodes.synopsis: "I went to get my hair cut with my dad. I was supposed to get a hairstyle like Momoe-chan, but this is Momoe-chan? Ah, Mom, you're a monster for telling me to go and return something you borrowed when I have hair like that."
episodes.title: Maruko's Crazy New Year's Eve
"Tama-chan's Halloween Party" / "Let's Read Lots of Books Together"

episodes.synopsis: "Hamaji's grandpa is having a great time at the mochi-pounding party? Maruko, I was trying hard to have a good dream and ended up having this dream. What, it's not a dream but reality? Is it true?"

episodes.synopsis: "Yay, it's finished! This is a pretty good karuta game. Oh, I just thought of one more. "If Nakano-san walks, he'll win the lottery." Hehe, that's good too. Let's all play!"
